name: radial
doc: A radial menu with submenus. Superset of ox registerRadial / addRadialItem and qb-radialmenu. Drawn by `radial-menu`. Resolves with the chosen item (and the path to it), or nil when closed.

label.doc: The centre's title when nothing is highlighted.

id.doc: Returned in the result. Default: the 1-based index as a string.

iconWidth.doc: Image icons only, % of the wedge.

menu.doc: ox-style submenu by id: selecting resolves with reason 'submenu' and this id, and the script opens it.

keepOpen.doc: Selecting emits 'select' and keeps the menu open.

sub.doc: This is a submenu (the centre shows back instead of close).

option.doc: The id of the submenu just left, so the page it lives on opens first (ox).

select.doc: An item with keepOpen was chosen.

back.doc: The centre was pressed on a submenu opened by id (`sub`): the script shows the parent.
